objective: When an operator changes a machine-candidate draft, stop the matching deferred Agent refinement before it can run more rounds or overwrite the operator's work.

client: Assign a fresh UUID to both single-frame and post-run deferred refinements.
Compare the active editable draft with the snapshot bound to that refinement.
On a real content change, invalidate the local generation and request cancellation for that exact UUID, frame and topic.
Do not cancel merely for selecting a shape, switching views or inspecting an unchanged draft.
server: Bind refinement_id into the live run status and every refinement response.
Cancel only when refinement_id, frame and topic all match the active task.
Retain a bounded five-minute cancellation intent so an edit arriving just before server registration closes the preflight race.
Keep candidate compare-and-swap, candidate-only status and human-truth isolation unchanged.

observed: matching cancellation stopped the request promptly
an unrelated UUID did not stop the active refinement
a preflight cancellation intent prevented model review from starting
candidates, Agent metadata and truth remained unchanged

first_windows_attempt.reason: The suite was first started without PYTHONUTF8=1, so existing UTF-8 Chinese fixtures were read through the Windows GBK default. The unchanged suite passed after restoring the project's required UTF-8 environment.

cancel_endpoint.meaning: The endpoint is live and correctly refused to stop a non-existent task.

safety_boundaries.current_inflight_model_call: Cancellation returns control to the workbench and prevents later Agent rounds, but an HTTP model call already executing underneath may finish naturally before releasing its GPU work.
